2609.09901.title: Deep and shallow biases in language models
2609.09901.paper_summary: Large language models often repeatedly select the same answer even when many alternatives are plausible. Prior work treats this concentration as bias, but it does not distinguish stable model preferences from responses that depend on a particular prompt wording. We introduce a bias depth score that measures both how strongly a model prefers its top answer under direct prompting and whether that answer survives scenario reframing. Across 4,442 opinion prompts and four large language models, only about a quarter of the concentrated preferences survive reframing. We call these persistent cases Deep biases, and the remaining prompt-dependent cases Shallow biases. Our results show that Deep biases are more often inherited from pretraining and preserved through SFT. Under both continued fine-tuning and prompt-based debiasing for diversity, Deep biases are consistently harder to remove than Shallow biases. Bias depth therefore separates stable learned biases from prompt-wording artifacts that single-prompt metrics conflate. Code, models, and data are available at deepbias.github.io.
2609.09901.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型經常重複選擇相同的答案，即使有許多替代選擇是合理的。<lb/>先前的研究將這種集中視為偏見，但並未區分穩定的模型偏好與依賴特定提示措辭的回應。<lb/>我們引入了一個偏見深度分數，該分數測量模型在直接提示下對其最佳答案的偏好強度，以及該答案是否能夠在情境重構中存活。<lb/>在4,442個意見提示和四個大型語言模型中，只有約四分之一的集中偏好能夠在重構中存活。<lb/>我們將這些持久的案例稱為深層偏見，而剩餘的依賴提示的案例稱為淺層偏見。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，深層偏見更常是從預訓練中繼承並通過SFT保持的。<lb/>在持續的微調和基於提示的去偏見以促進多樣性下，深層偏見始終比淺層偏見更難去除。<lb/>因此，偏見深度將穩定的學習偏見與單一提示指標混淆的提示措辭工件區分開來。<lb/>代碼、模型和數據可在deepbias.github.io獲得。
